h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kottayam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kottayam

items.pText: Kottayam has an unusually large number of schools, colleges and parish institutions for a town its size, and many of our enquiries from central Kerala come from them. These buyers want a playground that serves several classes on one ground, through heavy rain for much of the year. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sends it about 1,160 km by road to Kottayam.

Institutions usually plan a playground once and expect it to last, so we start with the details. Tell us the number of children who play at once, their ages and the dimensions of the ground. We will propose a layout with the safe play area marked, then manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment through our team or a south Indian dealer.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Zoning a school ground by age

c: A kindergarten child and a Class 6 student play very differently, and putting them on the same equipment causes most playground accidents we hear about. Divide the ground into zones. Spring riders, a toddler swing and a low slide go in one corner for ages 3 to 5. Older children get climbers, taller slides and a multi play system such as one from

Kottayam's rain falls through both monsoons, so place each zone on raised, well-drained ground and lay rubber flooring beneath. Teachers on duty should be able to see every zone from one spot. Read about fitness equipment for staff and parents on our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,160 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you plan a playground for a school with several age groups?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the ages and how many children play at a time. We divide the ground into zones and mark each safe play area on the layout drawing.

items.q: Does FunPlay install equipment in Kottayam district?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing.

items.q: What material should a Kerala school choose?
items.a: Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts. They handle constant humidity and two monsoons without rusting, and they carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
